newsitem.title: USA: Station Casinos provides quarterly outlook.
newsitem.headline: Station Casinos provides quarterly outlook.

text.p: Station Casinos Inc Wednesday provided preliminary quarter-to-date results from operations and development plans for Station Casino St., Charles and Sunset Station projects.

In a statement, the company said it expects to report strong results from its Nevada Operations for the current quarter, noting that its Palace Station casino has continued to perform steadily in light of new competition and should report single digit percentage gains in both net revenues and Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) over the prior year.

Station Casinos said its Boulder Station hotel and casino is expected to report another record quarter of net revenues and EBITDA with double-digit percentage gains over the prior year. Texas Station is expected to report much improved results with record revenue and EBITDA with margins approaching 20 percent.

The company said Station Casino Kansas City, which opened on January 16, generated net revenues of $24.3 million through the month of February and EBITDA margins for the quarter are expected to range between eight and 10 percent with margins improving in each consecutive month.
